دَعَجٌ (S, A, Msb, K) and ↓ دُعْجَةٌ (K) Blackness: or intense blackness: (TA:) or width, with blackness, of the eye: (Msb:) or intense blackness, with width, of the eye: (S, K:) or intense blackness in the eye, with intense whiteness thereof and width thereof: (A:) or intense blackness of the black of the eye, with intense whiteness of the white thereof; (Msb, * TA;) but accord. to Az, this is said only by Lth, and is a mistake. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also, the former, Blueness inclining to whiteness. (MF.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
